name: js-proxy-pool
description: Pure-JS/TS replacement for proxy-scraper-cli (Python). Scrapes free HTTP proxies from public GitHub lists, validates them (HTTPS-capable, low latency, no honeypot), exposes a rotating local proxy server on port 8792. Every request rotates to a different validated proxy IP. Auto-refills the pool in the background. No Python, no pip, no external deps beyond bun + undici.
